total_reo_country_context.warning: All-REE national production is not Nd/Pr/Dy/Tb production and cannot be assigned to a particular mine or alloy.

accounting_boundaries: All 17 rare-earth elements are selectable; coverage varies and missing records are explicit.
Fe and B are non-rare-earth constituents. DyFe and FeB carrier iron must be counted once within a batch.
Country labels identify mining/resource geography, not the metallization country or customs origin of a purchased alloy.
Named mine, regional aggregate, operating process, pilot and proposed project retain distinct statuses.
Quantities in evidence cards keep their native product, period and scope; no graph width is proportional to quantity.
No global element-specific production denominator, alloy input mix or mine-to-customer shipment is inferred.
